office_does: A State Representative writes and votes on Washington state law and the operating, capital and transportation budgets, covering school funding, tax structure, housing rules, health funding and criminal-justice statutes.
race_blurb: Democratic incumbent Clyde Shavers, a Navy veteran and attorney who has voted against the recent state tax increases, faces Republican Stanwood councilmember Robert (Chili) Hicks, a retired Navy Master Chief. They differ most on parental rights in schools, spending and abortion.

candidates.summary: Incumbent State Representative and Vice Chair of House Education, a Naval Academy graduate and Yale-trained attorney from Whidbey Island who campaigns on lowering costs and not raising taxes.
highlights: Voted no on the 2026 tax on income over $1 million, the 2025 gas-tax package, the services sales tax and the B&O increases [S7][S9][S10][S11]
Voted for the 2025 rent-increase limits (EHB 1217) and against the 2025 clean fuel standard bill [S12][S13]
Says he is "100 percent pro-choice"; voted for ESHB 1296, the parental-rights amendments I-1 would repeal [S3][S8]

taxes.basis: Voted against the income tax over $1M, the gas-tax package, the services sales tax and B&O increases, and states he does not support raising taxes.

spending.basis: Voted against the 2025-27 operating budget twice; no stated spending philosophy.

housing.basis: Voted for the 2025 rent-increase limits, and favors incentives for nonprofit affordable-housing development.

climate.basis: Backs a clean-energy economy and fusion research, but voted against the 2025 clean fuel standard bill and the gas-tax package.

safety.basis: General pledge to support law enforcement with resources and tools; no enforcement or prevention specifics.

experience.basis: Sitting representative and Education Committee vice chair, facing a first-term city councilmember.

social.basis: Repeatedly states he is "100 percent pro-choice"; endorsed by Planned Parenthood Alliance Advocates; no record on gender or sports policy.

parental-rights.basis: Voted for ESHB 1296, which amended and narrowed parts of the I-2081 parents' rights list; no campaign statement on the topic.

candidates.summary: Stanwood City Councilmember (elected 2024) and retired Navy Master Chief running on lower taxes, spending audits, enforcement-first public safety and parental rights.
highlights: Proposes lowering the sales tax, repealing the estate tax and stopping new taxes and fees [S3]
Calls for independent audits, public review of every major budget and performance-based funding [S3]
Would restore the original parents' bill of rights, require schools to post curricula and notify parents before non-emergency health services [S2][S3]
Supports police pursuits and a crackdown on fentanyl dealers, with treatment for those ready [S3]

taxes.basis: Pamphlet and platform pledge to lower taxes, cut the sales tax, repeal the estate tax and stop new taxes and fees.

spending.basis: Centers fiscal discipline, independent audits, public budget review and performance-based funding.

safety.basis: Platform centers police pursuits, full police funding, accountability for judges and prosecutors and a drug-dealer crackdown; treatment is secondary.

experience.basis: Local elected experience (Stanwood council since 2024) but no state legislative record, challenging an incumbent.

parental-rights.basis: Would restore the original parents' bill of rights, require curriculum posting, and require parent notice before non-emergency health services.
